item.description:
New • MCP server: connect Actvt to Claude Code and other AI tools so your agents can query live system metrics, ports, and session data on demand • On-device sensitive-data (PII) detection: Actvt now scans your agent transcripts for emails, cards, IDs, and secrets — fully offline, nothing leaves your Mac • Sensitive data is masked by default; reveal or hide it instantly with ⇧⌘P • A new "Has PII" Smart Collection surfaces every session with detected sensitive data • Copy any agent session as Markdown in one click
Improved • Live system metrics are now persisted, so your CPU, GPU, memory, and network history survives across launches • Reworked memory and thermal cards for clearer, more accurate readings • Larger, crisper menu bar icon • Updates now check on launch and install automatically on quit, with a smoother phased rollout • Full file paths are no longer shown, keeping your directory structure private
Fixed • Your license no longer expires when the app briefly can't reach the network • Fixed a deadlock that could cause the app to hang
